tokens.value: A pragmatic component framework that embraces jQuery's simplicity

Build modern web applications without the complexity of virtual DOM, state management, or build tool configuration nightmares. 
        JQHTML brings structure to jQuery while keeping the development experience simple and predictable.
No virtual DOM, no reconciliation, no magic. When you update the DOM, that IS the state change.
Components are genuine jQuery objects. Use all jQuery methods and plugins seamlessly.
Familiar ERB-style syntax that compiles to efficient JavaScript functions.
Works with script tags, webpack, or any build system. Your choice, not ours.
"Components are ES6 classes that extend the base Component class"
Here's a simple Greeting component in action:
"Components can be used in templates or created programmatically"
"Here I am, brain the size of a planet, and they ask me to manage state."
— What Marvin might say about React's Redux store

JQHTML believes the DOM is already a perfectly good state container. When you update the DOM, 
          that IS the state change. No reconciliation, no diffing, no wondering when your change will "commit."

We built JQHTML because 95% of web applications are CRUD interfaces that don't benefit from 
          architectural astronautics. jQuery has powered millions of production applications for nearly 
          two decades. JQHTML just adds the structure needed for modern component-based development.
